basis: The legend defines pale yellow as 'High' (100) and dark burgundy as 'Low' (0). Delaware (DE) is pale yellow, matching the highest end of the scale. Georgia (GA) is dark burgundy (lowest). Rhode Island (RI) is gray, which is not part of the prevalence scale and indicates missing data. Therefore, DE has the highest prevalence among the options.
option_label: Open Delaware (DE) prevalence detail for routine monitoring
